verses.26:50: قَالُواْ لَا ضَيۡرَۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ

meaning: The root ضير (Dyr) primarily means to harm, injure, or hurt someone or something. It is often used interchangeably with the root ضر (Drr), carrying a similar sense of causing damage or detriment.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
